review.summary: Inspected actual sheet, hero and full opposite view. Red/cream body and metallic lid are present, but the far side carries a conspicuous vertical black/red contaminated strip across the otherwise plain cream region, plus a sharp wrap seam. This is not a shape defect.

issues.problem: Unwanted black/red vertical markings interrupt the clean unbranded two-colour reference. Remove the contamination while retaining the red/cream boundary and metallic lid.

review.summary: Actual final/source sheet and full hero retain the can silhouette, red/cream wrap, metallic lid and pull tab after reduction. Fresh FBX/GLB validation passes at 14,471 triangles. No major missing rim, paint contamination or new crack is visible.

issues.problem: Neutral low shading shows small lower-wall undulations; the actual material largely compensates them. A few tiny surface specks and softened tab relief remain minor.

review.summary: Actual multiview sheet and full hero show a clean red/cream wrap and coherent metallic lid, tab and rims. The conspicuous black/red side contamination from t1 is absent. No major colour spill or new geometry defect.

issues.problem: The curved paint boundary differs slightly from the reference and shoulder highlights remain stronger; no major surface contamination is visible.

review.summary: Actual multiview sheet, full hero and top view show the can cylinder, tapered shoulder, continuous upper/lower rims, recessed lid and raised pull tab/rivet. The reference silhouette and principal lid details are retained.

issues.problem: The finger-slot relief is shallower/softer than the reference and the lower seam is slightly uneven; inspect metal shading and reduction for further loss.
